title: AirCatEnrollmentQrV1
description: Administrative AirCat Home enrollment QR payload returned by GET /api/v1/aircat/enrollment-qr

homeId.description: Canonical 43-char base64url BLAKE3 digest of Home Root public key

authorityMichiId.description: Canonical 43-char base64url Home Root authority Michi ID (equal to homeId)

authorityPublicKeyBase64Url.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 Home Root verifying key in base64url without padding

sourceMichiId.description: Canonical 43-char base64url Michi ID of the producer server

pinnedBaseUrl.description: Pinned HTTPS origin URL of the producer (cleartext HTTP forbidden)

tlsSpkiSha256.description: RFC 7469 SubjectPublicKeyInfo SHA-256 pin of the producer TLS certificate

nonceBase64Url.description: Cryptographic enrollment challenge nonce in base64url without padding

issuedAtMillis.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the QR payload was issued

expiresAtMillis.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the QR payload expires
